text: Sholay mein Gabbar ka pehla famous sawaal — 'Kitne aadmi the?' — usne kis se poocha tha?
source: Sholay (1975); the line is addressed to Kaalia and his two men returning from Ramgarh.

text: 2011 World Cup final mein Dhoni ka winning six kis bowler ki ball par laga tha?
source: ICC Cricket World Cup 2011 final, Wankhede Stadium; Kulasekara bowled the 49th-over delivery.

text: Vada pav ka janm — yaani pehli baar bech kar famous karna — kis sheher ke naam likha jaata hai?
source: Widely credited to Ashok Vaidya's stall outside Dadar station, Mumbai (1966).

text: Doordarshan ke Shaktimaan ka aam-zindagi wala roop kaun tha?
source: Shaktimaan (DD National, 1997–2005); alter ego Pandit Gangadhar Vidyadhar Mayadhar Omkarnath Shastri.

text: 'Washing powder ____, doodh si safedi…' — jingle poora karo.
source: Nirma detergent jingle, on Indian TV since the 1980s.

text: 90s ka pop anthem 'Made in India' kis singer ne gaya tha?
source: Alisha Chinai, 'Made in India' (1995), composed by Biddu.

text: 'Just looking like a wow!' — yeh viral line kis online seller ki thi?
source: Jasmeen Kaur's viral 2023 Instagram sales video; phrase later used by Deepika Padukone and global celebs.

text: India ka sabse lamba train route — Vivek Express — kahan se kahan tak chalta hai?
source: Vivek Express (train 15905/15906), ~4,247 km, Dibrugarh (Assam) to Kanyakumari (Tamil Nadu).

text: 'Pink City' ke naam se kaunsa sheher jaana jaata hai?
source: Jaipur, painted pink in 1876 for the visit of the Prince of Wales.

text: ISRO ka Mangalyaan mission Hollywood ki kis space film se bhi sasta tha?
source: Mars Orbiter Mission (~USD 74M, 2013–14) vs Gravity (~USD 100M); comparison famously cited by PM and NYT.

text: Mughal-e-Azam ka 'Pyar Kiya To Darna Kya' kis actress par filmaya gaya tha?
source: Mughal-e-Azam (1960); Madhubala as Anarkali, sung by Lata Mangeshkar.

text: Sachin Tendulkar ne apni 100th international century kis team ke khilaf banayi thi?
source: Asia Cup, 16 March 2012, vs Bangladesh at Mirpur.

text: 'Mogambo khush hua' — yeh iconic villain dialogue kis film ka hai?
source: Mr. India (1987), Amrish Puri as Mogambo.

text: Hyderabadi 'kachchi' biryani mein 'kachchi' kis cheez ke liye hai?
source: Kachchi biryani: raw marinated meat layered with parboiled rice and dum-cooked.

text: Malgudi Days kis lekhak ki kahaniyon par based tha?
source: Malgudi Days (DD, 1986), from R.K. Narayan's short stories; sketches by his brother R.K. Laxman.

text: P.T. Usha 1984 Olympics ke 400m hurdles final mein kitne antar se medal se chuki thin?
source: Los Angeles 1984; Usha finished 4th, 1/100th of a second behind bronze.

text: A.R. Rahman ko pehla Oscar kis film ke liye mila tha?
source: Slumdog Millionaire (2009 ceremony): Best Original Score and Best Original Song ('Jai Ho').

text: Camlin geometry box ke 'divider' ka asli, official kaam kya hai?
source: A divider's function in technical drawing is measuring/transferring distances (every Indian school geometry box).

text: Nagpur ke viral Dolly Chaiwala ne 2024 mein kis billionaire ko chai pilai thi?
source: Bill Gates' February 2024 'One cup of chai away' video with Dolly Chaiwala went globally viral.

text: RRR ke 'Naatu Naatu' ne kaunsa Academy Award jeeta?
source: 95th Academy Awards (2023): 'Naatu Naatu' won Best Original Song (M.M. Keeravani, Chandrabose).

text: Amul girl apne cartoons mein hamesha kaunsi dress mein dikhti hai?
source: The Amul moppet (since 1966, daCunha agency) wears her signature red polka-dotted frock.

text: Kolkata ke Howrah Bridge ka official naam kya hai?
source: Renamed Rabindra Setu in 1965 after Rabindranath Tagore.

text: Kishore Kumar ne record kitni baar Filmfare Best Male Playback Singer award jeeta?
source: Kishore Kumar holds the record with 8 Filmfare Best Male Playback awards.

text: Kamasutra originally kis bhasha mein likha gaya tha?
source: Vatsyayana's Kamasutra, composed in Sanskrit (~3rd century CE).
